title: A little twist
tip: Tap a tile to rotate it. Join the source to the gold target.

title: Find your flow
tip: Light travels only through matching connections.

title: Around the bend
tip: Follow the path. You can undo any move.

title: Two destinations
tip: Every gold target needs energy. T-junctions divide the flow.

title: The long way
tip: Some paths are distractions. Trace the useful connections.

title: Cross currents
tip: Four-way junctions carry energy in every direction.

title: Anchored
tip: Tiles with a small lock stay fixed. Build around them.

title: Between the anchors
tip: Use fixed tiles as clues to the route.

title: Hold the center
tip: Two targets, one anchored junction.

title: Open sesame
tip: Tap the switch. Its matching gate opens.

title: Switchback
tip: Switches toggle instead of rotating. Open the gate, then route energy.

title: Double permission
tip: Lettered switches control their matching gates.

title: Go with the arrow
tip: Arrow tiles carry energy in one direction only.

title: A directed detour
tip: Turn the arrows to follow the flow, not oppose it.

title: No turning back
tip: One source can still feed several directed routes.

title: Three ways forward
tip: A splitter takes energy at its arrow tail and sends it out through three arms.

title: Divide and deliver
tip: Align the splitter input first. Then complete each branch.

title: A change of color
tip: A color tile tints neutral energy. Match the target color.

title: Separate spectra
tip: Split neutral energy before tinting it. Different colors cannot mix.

title: The MindFlip
tip: Everything connects: switch, split, direct, and color the flow.
